categories.main_business_segments: KR Motors primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of two-wheeled vehicles, including motorcycles and electric scooters. The company also engages in the production and sales of parts related to internal combustion engines and electric vehicle components. Additionally, it has business activities in vehicle rental, distribution, and after-sales services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technology for designing and producing engines ranging from 50cc to 700cc, including high-displacement engines up to 700cc. It has developed electric two-wheelers with battery swapping systems (BSS) in collaboration with major partners like LG Energy Solution and Hyundai Kefico. Production is carried out mainly at its Changwon plant and a joint venture factory in Jinan, China, with a focus on meeting EURO5 emission standards and electric vehicle certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KR Motors serves both domestic and international markets, targeting commercial delivery sectors, leisure riders, and general consumers. Key markets include South Korea, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia, with a focus on high-displacement motorcycles overseas and low to mid-displacement scooters domestically. The company also supplies public institutions and partners with rental and leasing companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Changwon and a joint venture in Jinan, China. It exports to major markets including the United States, Europe, Australia, Southeast Asia (notably Laos and Thailand), and has established distribution partnerships in Taiwan. Domestic sales are supported by a network of dealerships and distributors.
categories.supply_chain_position: KR Motors operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of complete two-wheeled vehicles and related components. It sources key raw materials and parts from global suppliers such as BOSCH and SYM and assembles finished products for sale through its distribution channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-displacement internal combustion engines compliant with EURO5 standards and expanding its electric vehicle lineup, including battery swapping technology and three-wheeled electric scooters. It invests in developing environmentally friendly technologies, improving product quality, and expanding overseas market penetration. Collaborations with LG Energy Solution and Hyundai Kefico highlight its focus on electric mobility innovation.
categories.revenue_model: KR Motors generates revenue primarily through the sale of motorcycles and electric two-wheelers, both domestically and internationally. Sales channels include dealerships, direct sales to public institutions, and partnerships with rental and leasing companies. The company also earns revenue from after-sales services and distribution agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic manufacturers like Daelim Motors and numerous imported brands, including Honda and SYM. KR Motors holds approximately 16-20% domestic market share in manufacturing and is recognized as the only domestic maker with a full lineup from 50cc to 700cc engines. It positions itself as a quality-focused manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities, especially in high-displacement and electric motorcycles.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: KR Motors reported revenues of approximately 78.4 billion KRW in the latest fiscal year, down 33% from the previous year, with a net loss of about 21 billion KRW. The company has a capital base of around 48 billion KRW and total assets of approximately 138.6 billion KRW. Despite recent financial challenges, it has a history of growth and is investing in restructuring and new product development to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KR Motors differentiates itself through its proprietary engine technology covering a wide displacement range and its pioneering development of electric two-wheelers with battery swapping systems. The company emphasizes high-quality, environmentally compliant products tailored for both domestic commercial use and international leisure markets. Its strategic partnerships and comprehensive product lineup aim to meet diverse customer needs and regulatory requirements.
